purpose: Adopt configurable turbine idle fuel flow into the app runtime. FGTurbine derived IdleFF from rated thrust alone (107 * milthrust^0.2), which for the SF50's 1,846 lbf is 481.5 lbm/hr, or 71.4 US gph. Fuel flow is floored at that value, so the WPR20FA051 recorder's 76 lbm/hr ground idle and the two lowest printed AFM cruise rows were unreachable.
behaviourChange: intended, turbine idle fuel flow only; the derived estimate is kept when <idlefuelflow> is absent

source.note: The element is validated before FGEngine::Load ties engine properties. Rejecting it afterwards left the ties behind for an engine that was never constructed, and destroying the executive then crashed in FGPropertyManager::Unbind. TSFC and ATSFC functions are still constructed after that point, so that path is unchanged.

runtimeEvidence.method: The app's own public/jsbsim-data SF50 package is written into the SDK's virtual filesystem, loaded, and trimmed on the runway with the thrust lever closed. The package declares <idlefuelflow>76</idlefuelflow>; the check compares the reported idle fuel flow with that figure and with FGTurbine's 481.5 lbm/hr fallback.

fork6.observed: 481.5 lbm/hr (71.44 US gph) at 24.3 % N1 and 53.4 % N2: the rated-thrust fallback, so the element was ignored.

fork7.observed: 76.0 lbm/hr (11.28 US gph) at the same spool speeds, 0.000 % from the declared value.

runtimeEvidence.significance: The negative control for this adoption: the identical script fails on the retained fork.6 tarball and passes on fork.7, so the change is attributable to this package and not to the SF50 package or the harness.

commands: node --test test/*.test.mjs (frozen SDK workspace and resolved native fixtures)

sf50AfmBaseline.note: Run with the recalibrated SF50 package on this artifact. Every takeoff metric and every landing ground roll and total distance is within the 15 % benchmark tolerance; the two landing airborne distances that already failed before this work still fail, at -15.5 % and -18.8 %. Static thrust 1771.9 lbf, -4.0 % of the 1,846 lbf rating.

notAttempted: No WASM/native parity report was produced for this release. fork.6's parity report stands for the shared engine revision; this change alters only turbine idle fuel flow and is covered by the negative control above.
No browser persistence or release-pack run was repeated for this release.
The app suite result is not recorded here because the working tree carries another agent's uncommitted work; the three failures in it are in that work, not in the JSBSim path.
